title: Duplicate global user_roles grant rows on every idempotent role grant (approve replay, role re-grant)
expected: Exactly one user_roles row per (user,role,global); approve replay is a no-op
actual: Each replay inserted a fresh ACTIVE row — live-proved: 2 identical marketplace_seller grants 82ms apart. UNIQUE never fires because scope_id is NULL and Postgres treats NULLs as distinct; ON CONFLICT(...scope_id) silently never matches
root_cause: ON CONFLICT clause names a column that is always NULL for global grants, so the intended dedup never engages

title: go-forward.spec.ts asserts Go-forward failures using stale colon-prefixed Paystack references
expected: 3 'throws on failure' cases reach the fetch and exercise retry semantics
actual: Cases used 'feespay:x'/'rideorder:y'/'duespay:z' — colon refs are no longer Go-owned since e43e3d8b0 switched every rail to '-' separators, so goOwned=false and the fn resolved {processed:false} before fetch; 3 tests failed on main
root_cause: Spec drifted behind the reference-separator change; tests were vacuous (never reached the code under test)

title: frontend-web middleware lets all pages through when Supabase env is unset (fail-open page gate)

actual: Missing NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL/ANON_KEY returns NextResponse.next() for every path including /profile etc.
root_cause: Documented dev/test escape hatch; real exposure limited because API routes do their own auth — noted for hardening review, no live exploit path
